setup: VPC=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=shop-prod --query 'Vpcs[0].VpcId' --output text) && aws elbv2 create-target-group --name shop-ecs --vpc-id $VPC --protocol HTTP --port 8080 --target-type ip --health-check-path /health > /dev/null

CERT=$(aws acm request-certificate --domain-name shop.example.com --query CertificateArn --output text) && LB=$(aws elbv2 describe-load-balancers --names shop-alb --query 'LoadBalancers[0].LoadBalancerArn' --output text) && TG=$(aws elbv2 describe-target-groups --names shop-app --query 'TargetGroups[0].TargetGroupArn' --output text) && aws elbv2 create-listener --load-balancer-arn $LB --protocol HTTPS --port 443 --certificates CertificateArn=$CERT --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$TG > /dev/null
